sections.what: Defines the three possible tabs: collation, evidence feed and agent trace, with the header explaining when each appears.

sections.name: RunPanelTabs
sections.title: Tab switching and the panel
sections.what: Chooses which tab is visible, builds the tab buttons, and keeps both feed and trace loaded while hiding whichever is not chosen. Collation is shown only in dark mode and only when provided.
sections.why: The header says both views stay mounted so the trace keeps its pace while the feed is showing.
sections.watch_out: The tab falls back to the feed if collation was chosen but is no longer available, so the owner may not notice the change.

summary: Switches the run panel between an evidence feed, an agent trace and, in dark mode only, a collation view.
purpose: Lets the owner look at the run's evidence or the agent's step trace without leaving the run view.
why: The header says both views stay mounted so the trace keeps its place and its caught-up signal while the feed is showing.
how: 1. Checks whether dark mode is on and whether a collation view was supplied. 2. Builds the tab list, with collation first only in dark mode. 3. Uses the chosen tab, or a default if none is chosen or the chosen tab is no longer available. 4. Shows the matching panel and hides the others without unmounting them.
inputs: The feed, trace and optional collation content, the panel height and outer spacing, and the current theme.
outputs: A row of tab buttons and one visible panel.
risks: Hidden panels keep running in the background, so work in them is not paused by switching tabs.
debug: If a tab is missing, check the theme state and whether the collation content was passed in. If the panel is the wrong height, check the panel height setting.
